Class DrawUpdateMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.messages.server.DrawUpdateMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerMessage, Serializable
public class DrawUpdateMessage extends Object implements ServerMessage
Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player draws a card.
